Leave **B01–B07** blank for preschool/daycare staff. Your sister can complete the entries marked **NEEDS-YOU**. The preschool/daycare name is needed in both the title and B08.

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| B08 | I hereby make application for admission of NEEDS-YOU to the NEEDS-YOU Preschool/Daycare. The blanks are for your nephew’s name and the preschool/daycare name. |
| B09 Applicant name | MARICEL BUENAFLOR ESCALANTE |
| B10 Applicant phone | +65 8555 0143 |
| B11 Applicant email | NEEDS-YOU — your email address |
| B12 Relationship to child | Aunt |
| B13 Child’s name | NEEDS-YOU |
| B14 Person the child lives with | NEEDS-YOU |
| B15 Address for the child’s household | NEEDS-YOU |
| B16 Number of children in the family | (M) NEEDS-YOU / (F) NEEDS-YOU |
| B17 Child’s place in the family | NEEDS-YOU — birth order |
| B18 Mother’s name | NEEDS-YOU |
| B19 Mother’s address | NEEDS-YOU |
| B20 Mother’s phone numbers | (C) NEEDS-YOU / (W) NEEDS-YOU / (H) NEEDS-YOU |
| B21 Mother’s email | NEEDS-YOU |
| B22 Mother’s occupation | NEEDS-YOU |
| B23 Father’s name | NEEDS-YOU |
| B24 Father’s address | NEEDS-YOU |
| B25 Father’s phone numbers | (C) NEEDS-YOU / (W) NEEDS-YOU / (H) NEEDS-YOU |
| B26 Father’s email | NEEDS-YOU |
| B27 Father’s occupation | NEEDS-YOU |
| B28 People authorized to collect the child | NEEDS-YOU |
| B29 First emergency contact | Name NEEDS-YOU / (C) NEEDS-YOU / (W) NEEDS-YOU / (H) NEEDS-YOU |
| B30 Second emergency contact | MARICEL BUENAFLOR ESCALANTE |
| B30 Second emergency contact phone | +65 8555 0143 |

In B10 and B30, put your restored phone number in the matching slot by hand. **C** is cell, **W** is work, and **H** is home. Any additional phone numbers the form requires are **NEEDS-YOU**.
